title: Identity tangent infinitesimal-point transport
statement: For a field k and group scheme G over Spec k, writing x for the identity and r for the structural residue map, there is an equivalence e : infPoints G ≃ schemeTangentSpace k G.left G.hom x whose underlying morphism is Spec.map (DualNumber.mapRingHom r) composed with the corresponding tangent-group point.

proof.text: The identity residue rationality theorem supplies a bijective structural residue map a and Spec.map a followed by the identity section equals the canonical residue point. Regard a as an isomorphism of commutative rings. Naturality of the augmentation and constants inclusion gives cK composed with d = b composed with ck and d composed with qk = qK composed with b, for d the dual-number spectrum map and b = Spec.map a. The identity section equation also gives the canonical residue point composed with the structural morphism = b.

For a tangent-group point v, precompose its underlying morphism by d. The first naturality identity and v reducing to the identity prove the tangent closed-point condition; the second identity and v being an over-morphism prove the tangent base condition. This gives the forward function.

The forward function is injective because d is an epimorphism and equality of underlying maps detects over-morphisms and subtype points. For a tangent vector theta use inv d composed with theta as an over-morphism; its over equation follows from the second naturality identity and its reducing-to-identity equation from the first one after cancelling b. This gives a tangent-group point. Both inverse identities follow by cancelling d with inv d. Compose this type equivalence with infPointsEquivTangentGroup.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_identity_tangent_transport
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] :
    let x := unitSection G (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
    let r : k →+* G.left.residueField x :=
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (G.hom x) ≫ G.hom.stalkMap x ≫ G.left.residue x).hom
    ∃ e : infPoints G ≃ schemeTangentSpace k G.left G.hom x,
      ∀ v : infPoints G, (e v).val =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (DualNumber.mapRingHom r)) ≫
          (infPointsEquivTangentGroup G v).val.left
